params.prompt: Locked-camera real-time casino broadcast of ONE professional blackjack pickup and compact turn, then a natural hold in the exact last pose. FIRST 0.7 SECOND: starting with both hands empty adjacent to shoe, her left hand at viewer right immediately draws one red-backed card OUT THROUGH THE LOW FRONT SHOE MOUTH. Her already-waiting right hand receives it beside the mouth. In a single economical wrist roll lasting about 0.15 seconds the rigid card briefly tips and rotates from red back to white printed face, its lower edge stays just above felt, fingers retain physical contact; she immediately lays it FACE UP low next to the shoe exactly as final image. No travel toward torso centre, no raising to chest, no presentation hold, no second card. REST OF CLIP: maintain the final low fingertip-contact pose with only subtle natural breathing. The card is rigid: visible perspective narrows then broadens in the turn, never a texture crossfade. Card originates INSIDE shoe, not fingers or midair. Same Astrid identity, full black sleeves to wrists, ivory blouse, room/table markings, shoe and fixed camera. Silent, no speech, no cuts or dissolve. Prioritize continuous credible hand contact and a quick practical card turnover.

content.text: This tool provides an auto-updating generation widget for these jobs. Do not call job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids to display these jobs again, either before or after completion, unless the user explicitly requests a separate display. If you need to await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15. Use job_display only if the user explicitly requests a separate re-display of one specific job.

Submitted 1 job. If a widget is visible, it polls automatically — do not call job_status or show_generations as a follow-up poll. In text-only clients, use job_status with sync:true to poll for completion.
